parties.name: Harbor & Pine Foods Ltd
parties.quote: Harbor & Pine Foods Ltd, a company registered in Lagos, Nigeria (the "Client")

parties.name: Brightline Studio Ltd
parties.quote: Brightline Studio Ltd, a design agency registered in Accra, Ghana (the "Agency")

items.title: Name a project lead and notify the Client
items.quote: The Agency shall name a project lead and notify the Client of that person within five (5) business days of the Effective Date.
items.due_text: within five (5) business days of the Effective Date

items.title: Deliver the discovery report
items.quote: The Agency shall deliver a discovery report summarising user research and site analytics by 20 November 2026.

items.title: Provide page copy, photos and brand assets
items.quote: The Client shall provide all final page copy, product photographs and brand assets no later than 27 November 2026.
items.reason: Client input needed on a date.

items.title: Deliver the design mockups
items.quote: The Agency shall deliver high-fidelity design mockups for the home, menu, locations and contact pages by 11 December 2026.

items.title: Approve the mockups or request changes
items.quote: The Client shall approve the design mockups or request changes within ten (10) business days of receiving them.
items.due_text: within ten (10) business days of receiving them

items.title: Launch the completed website
items.quote: The Agency shall launch the completed website on the Client's hosting by 29 January 2027.

items.title: Pay the deposit
items.quote: The Client shall pay a deposit of USD 4,500 within seven (7) days of the Effective Date.
items.due_text: within seven (7) days of the Effective Date

items.title: Pay the design-stage instalment
items.quote: The Client shall pay USD 6,000 on 18 December 2026, following delivery of the design mockups.

items.title: Pay the final instalment
items.quote: The Client shall pay the final instalment of USD 4,500 by 12 February 2027.

items.title: Fix reported defects within two business days
items.quote: For three (3) months after launch the Agency shall fix reported defects within two (2) business days of each report.
items.due_text: within two (2) business days of each report

items.title: Renew the domain and hosting
items.quote: The Client shall renew its domain name and hosting plan before they expire on 31 March 2027.

items.title: Send the monthly status report
items.quote: The Agency shall send the Client a written status report on the first business day of each month.
items.due_text: on the first business day of each month

items.title: Maintain professional indemnity insurance
items.quote: The Agency shall maintain professional indemnity insurance of at least USD 250,000 for the duration of this Agreement.
items.due_text: for the duration of this Agreement

items.title: Pay a launch bonus
items.quote: The Client shall pay a launch bonus of USD 1,000 on launch day.
